TsDyn is a R package designed to modelling nonlinearitiies in time
series. It entails following *nonlinear regression models*

- * Smooth transition regression model (star)
- * Logistic smooth transition regressions models (lstar)
- * Threshold autoregressive models (setar and tar)
- * Neural Network nonlinear autoregressive model(nnet)
- * Additive nonlinear autoregressive model (aar)
+ * Smooth transition regression model (_star_)
+ * Logistic smooth transition regressions models (_lstar_)
+ * Threshold autoregressive models (_setar_)
+ * Neural Network nonlinear autoregressive model(_nnet_)
+ * Additive nonlinear autoregressive model (_aar_)

It has also various *nonlinearity and independance tests* like:

- * Casdagli test of nonlinearity via locally linear forecasts (llar)
- * Generic NLAR linearity test (isLinear)
+ * Casdagli test of nonlinearity via locally linear forecasts (_llar_)
+ * Generic NLAR linearity test (_isLinear_)
